description: Source code for managing plugin environment in Mattermost, including plugin activation, deactivation, reattachment, status reporting, and webapp bundle handling.

classes.name: registeredPlugin
classes.description: Stores plugin state, info, and supervisor reference for active or attempted plugins.

classes.name: PrepackagedPlugin
classes.description: Represents a plugin that is prepackaged with the server, including its path, manifest, and signature.

classes.name: Environment
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle, status, and environment of active plugins within Mattermost.

methods.name: NewEnvironment
methods.description: Creates a new plugin environment with specified parameters.

methods.name: scanSearchPath
methods.description: Performs a non-recursive scan of a directory to find plugin bundles.

methods.name: Available
methods.description: Returns all available plugins in the plugin directory.

methods.name: PrepackagedPlugins
methods.description: Returns list of prepackaged plugins.

methods.name: TransitionallyPrepackagedPlugins
methods.description: Returns list of transitionally prepackaged plugins.

methods.name: ClearTransitionallyPrepackagedPlugins
methods.description: Clears the list of transitionally prepackaged plugins.

methods.name: Active
methods.description: Returns list of currently active plugins.

methods.name: IsActive
methods.description: Checks if a plugin with given id is active.

methods.name: SetPluginError
methods.description: Sets error message for a plugin.

methods.name: getPluginError
methods.description: Retrieves error message for a plugin.

methods.name: GetPluginState
methods.description: Returns current state of a plugin.

methods.name: setPluginState
methods.description: Updates the state of a plugin.

methods.name: setPluginSupervisor
methods.description: Associates a supervisor with a plugin.

methods.name: PublicFilesPath
methods.description: Returns the public files path for an active plugin.

methods.name: Statuses
methods.description: Returns status info for all plugins.

methods.name: GetManifest
methods.description: Retrieves the manifest for a plugin by id.

methods.name: checkMinServerVersion
methods.description: Checks if plugin meets minimum server version requirements.

methods.name: startPluginServer
methods.description: Starts a plugin server with given plugin info and options.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates a plugin by id, starting its server and webapp if applicable.

methods.name: Reattach
methods.description: Reattaches to an existing plugin instance.

methods.name: RemovePlugin
methods.description: Removes plugin from environment.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates a plugin by id.

methods.name: RestartPlugin
methods.description: Restarts a plugin by deactivating and reactivating it.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down all plugins and environment.

methods.name: UnpackWebappBundle
methods.description: Unpacks webapp bundle for a plugin.

methods.name: HooksForPlugin
methods.description: Returns hooks API for a plugin.

methods.name: RunMultiPluginHook
methods.description: Runs a hook across all plugins implementing it.

methods.name: PerformHealthCheck
methods.description: Checks health of a plugin.

methods.name: SetPrepackagedPlugins
methods.description: Sets the list of prepackaged and transitionally prepackaged plugins.

methods.name: TogglePluginHealthCheckJob
methods.description: Enables or disables the plugin health check job.

methods.name: GetPluginHealthCheckJob
methods.description: Returns the current plugin health check job.
